title: Native conversation shared run context
description: Requires an owned private gateway, a real accepted native worker in a disposable workspace, and its verified fixture receipt. Drive the actual connection form, composer and Send. Delay unchanged real run/transcript responses through a loopback-only proxy, update the run through another client, and cancel/delete only that owned fixture. Restore the original profile and close the proxy. No UI/cache values are injected and no other worker receives input. Offline transcript persistence remains separate fleet/session acceptance.

proofTargets.claim: The actual pinned native conversation observes canonical run changes without rereading run.get on every transcript poll or resetting its cursor and draft.
A withheld real run reply leaves saved data visible and the actual Send disabled until current data returns.
One actual composer submission reaches the exact worker lease once, produces an assistant reply and reconciles its command receipt.
A real nonempty transcript reply from a removed run cannot advance the current cursor or timeline; contextual Retry remains a read and sends no command.

before.intent: Open the owned iOS session before the native worker proof.

prove.intent: Drive the real composer and verify run, reply and command ownership.

shared.intent: Require canonical updates, preserved paging and no per-poll run reads.

ready.intent: Keep actual Send disabled while a real run reply is withheld.

accepted.intent: Require one accepted command and the real worker's reply.

retired.intent: Drop a real reply for the removed run without advancing its timeline.
